class.name: RailVehicleDieselEngine
class.brief_description: Diesel engine handler class, for vehicles with a mechanical transmission (gearbox, optional torque converter and retarder).
class.description: Class handling diesel engines with a mechanical transmission. Vehicles with an electric transmission ([code]EngineType=DieselElectric[/code]) should use [RailVehicleDieselElectricEngine] instead, which extends this class with the electric-transmission-specific FIZ fields (and [member RailVehicleDieselElectricEngine.wwlist]).
